2101.meaning1: surpassed; gone beyond; overcome; surmounted; transcended
2101.commentary: (THa) anejo so, gavampati, taṃ sabbasaṅg'ātigataṃ tādisaṃ sabbe'pi rāga-dosa-moha-māna-diṭṭhi-saṅge atikkamitvā ṭhitattā sabbasaṅg'ātigataṃ
